data.name: Winnifred
data.gender_notes: Winnifred is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English 'wynn' (joy) and 'frið' (peace). This name was popular in the Middle Ages and was often given to girls born into wealthy families. It conveys a sense of joy and tranquility, and is often associated with the Christian virtues of kindness and faithfulness. The name Winnifred carries the meaning “Friend of peace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Winnifred usually hope their child will grow to embody friend of peace and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Winnifred total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
